headline: Egypt's Early Shock Succumbs to Argentine Second-Half Surge
story: Egypt stunned Argentina with two goals from low-xG situations in the opening hour, exploiting gaps as Messi and company searched for rhythm. Yet Argentina controlled play throughout (57% possession, 19 shots to Egypt's five), squandering three big chances before half-time. The shape shifted decisively from the 79th minute: Argentina's press—nine high-pressure phases to Egypt's four—suffocated the midfield, with ball recovery time dropping to 14.1 seconds versus Egypt's labored 21.3.

Argentina's 2.63 expected-goals advantage over Egypt's 0.76 proved decisive once late intensity took hold. Messi's 8.7 rating and Romero's defensive leadership at 7.4 anchored a surge that exposed Egypt's exhaustion; high-press frequency at 9.9 to 3.9 meant there was nowhere to hide in midfield. Egypt's ruthless early finishing (0.74 combined xG on two goals) couldn't withstand Argentina's second-half dominance: three goals in fourteen minutes between 79' and 90+2' sealed the rout.

keyMoment.text: Argentina's press finally broke through: momentum shifted irrevocably toward an avalanche of goals.

home.verdict: Dominance delayed but delivered: relentless second-half pressing overwhelmed an exhausted defence.
points: 9.9 high-press phases vs Egypt's 3.9 created pressure that forced 39 turnovers to clinch late victory.
Recovery time of 14.1 seconds vs Egypt's 21.3 made late transitions lethal as fatigue compounded.
Three big chances (xG 0.79, 0.30, 0.26) wasted early; Messi's 8.7 and Romero's 7.4 stayed dangerous.

away.verdict: Clinical early, pressed into submission—dominance gap and recovery lag proved insurmountable late.
points: Two goals from 0.74 xG showed ruthlessness; 0.76 total xG left no margin against Argentina.
High-press gap (3.9 vs 9.9) meant no intensity to sustain the early lead when fatigue set in.
Ball recovery 21.3 seconds (7.2 seconds slower) made defending impossible under intense late press.

statLine: Argentina's expected-goals advantage of 2.63 to 0.76 translated to victory only through a fourteen-minute final-quarter explosion.
